papers.title: Microstructure and mechanical properties investigation of CP titanium processed by selective laser melting (SLM)
papers.first_author_affiliation: Materialscare Sp. z o.o., Zwierzyniecka 10/1 Str., 15-333 Bialystok, Poland

corresponding_authors.name: Bartłomiej Wysocki
corresponding_authors.affiliation: Materialscare Sp. z o.o., Zwierzyniecka 10/1 Str., 15-333 Bialystok, Poland

llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文仅涉及SLM钛的力学性能，未涉及多孔结构、应力遮挡或骨整合等生物医学植入物关键问题。
llm.why_not_core: Does not address porous structures, stress shielding, fatigue, surface roughness, or osseointegration relevant to biomedical implants.

summary_zh.motivation: 研究SLM制备CP钛的微观结构及力学性能。
summary_zh.method: 通过SLM工艺参数调控，分析显微组织与拉伸、硬度等力学性能。
summary_zh.result: 发现工艺参数对相组成和力学性能有显著影响。
summary_zh.validation: 实验力学测试验证材料性能。

summary_en.motivation: To investigate the microstructure and mechanical properties of commercially pure titanium fabricated by selective laser melting.
summary_en.method: Controlled SLM processing parameters and characterized the resulting microstructure via SEM and XRD, along with tensile and hardness tests.
summary_en.result: Processing parameters significantly influenced phase composition and mechanical performance.
summary_en.validation: Mechanical testing (tensile, hardness) validated the material properties.

papers.title: Biofabrication of polyphenols stabilized reduced graphene oxide and its anti-tuberculosis activity
papers.first_author_affiliation: Department II of Tuberculosis Medicine, The First Affiliated Hospital of Xinxiang Medical University, Xinxiang, Henan 453100, China

corresponding_authors.name: Cui Xiu-qin
corresponding_authors.affiliation: Department II of Tuberculosis Medicine, The First Affiliated Hospital of Xinxiang Medical University, Xinxiang, Henan 453100, China. Electronic address: cuixiuqin123@hotmail.com

papers.venue: Journal of Photochemistry and Photobiology B Biology

llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文涉及生物制造还原氧化石墨烯的抗结核活性，与AI生物打印方向无关。
llm.why_not_core: This paper does not involve AI/ML, bioprinting workflow, or any computational modeling; it is purely a materials chemistry study for anti-tuberculosis application.

summary_zh.motivation: 开发具有抗结核活性的还原氧化石墨烯生物材料
summary_zh.method: 利用多酚稳定还原氧化石墨烯并进行生物制造
summary_zh.result: 制备的材料表现出抗结核活性
summary_zh.validation: 体外抗结核活性实验验证

summary_en.motivation: To develop reduced graphene oxide biomaterials with anti-tuberculosis activity.
summary_en.method: Polyphenols were used to stabilize reduced graphene oxide for biofabrication.
summary_en.result: The fabricated material exhibited anti-tuberculosis activity.

papers.title: Uncertainty quantification in littoral erosion
papers.first_author_affiliation: Université de Montpellier, Mathématiques (IMAG) CC51, 34095 Montpellier, France

corresponding_authors.name: Bijan Mohammadi
corresponding_authors.affiliation: Université de Montpellier, Mathématiques (IMAG) CC51, 34095 Montpellier, France

llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文研究海岸侵蚀的不确定性量化，与生物力学或植入物设计无关。
llm.why_not_core: No FEA surrogate modeling, no biomedical context, no implant design or biomechanics application.

summary_zh.motivation: 量化海岸侵蚀模型中的不确定性。
summary_zh.method: 采用随机模拟方法进行不确定性传播。
summary_zh.result: 识别了关键不确定性来源及其对侵蚀预测的影响。
summary_zh.validation: 基于数值模拟案例验证。

summary_en.motivation: To quantify uncertainties in littoral erosion models for improved coastal management.
summary_en.method: Stochastic simulation methods are employed to propagate input uncertainties through the erosion model.
summary_en.result: Key sources of uncertainty are identified and their impact on erosion predictions is assessed.
summary_en.validation: Validation is performed through numerical simulation case studies.
